findings.title: Tax page's default year selection has no activity, reads as an empty ledger
findings.observed: Landing on /tax fresh (right after my first two fills) selects tax year 2025 by default (confirmed via document.querySelector('select').value === '2025'). The page reads: 'No 2025 activity at all. The ledger holds 3 transactions, none of them dated in this tax year -- pick another year above.' The ledger's only three transactions -- my deposit and two buys -- are all dated 2026. Switching the select to 2026 immediately surfaces them: 'Nothing was disposed of in 2026. The ledger holds 3 transactions dated in this tax year -- see Activity -- but no lot was sold.'
findings.expected: The default year should be the one that actually has data -- either the current calendar year or the most recent year present in the ledger -- not a year picked independent of the ledger's contents. A tax page's first impression on a fresh session should not be an absence claim about a ledger that in fact holds every transaction I have made.
findings.why_it_matters: I read tax exposure at decision time, per my mandate. If I trust the first screen I land on, I would conclude the tax page has not picked up my trading yet and stop checking it -- exactly the wrong read one session before I need this page's wash-sale panel to size an exit. A new user with a real book would reasonably conclude the import failed.
repro: Fill at least one order so the ledger has 2026-dated transactions.
Note the year <select>'s value is 2025 (one year behind the ledger's actual activity), and the panel below states no 2025 activity exists.
Manually switch the select to 2026 -- the same three transactions are now found and the message changes to the correct 'nothing disposed of' copy.
findings.suggested_fix: Default the year select to the most recent year that has ledger transactions (falling back to the current calendar year if the ledger is empty), rather than a fixed offset from today's date.
